items.description: This repo aggregates the most impactful LLM‑centric work in cybersecurity, grouped by real‑world problem domains. Whether you’re building an autonomous SOC analyst, crafting threat profiles, or automating detection rule writing or exploring offensive workflows like red teaming, jump straight to the topic area that matters most.
items.title: About
🤖 CAI (aliasrobotics/cai)
items.description: [Tool/GitHub] - Cybersecurity-focused AI tooling from Alias Robotics (automation/agent experiments).

items.title: 📚 awesome-foundation-agents
items.description: [Awesome List/GitHub] - Curated list of foundation-model agent resources (general agent ecosystem context).

items.title: 🤖 Cyber Security llm Agents
items.description: [Tool/GitHub] - A collection of agents using LLMs (built on AutoGen) to perform common cybersecurity tasks, showcased at RSAC 2024.
This section covers resources related to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for security. These systems facilitate more complex and coordinated AI-driven security operations.

items.title: 🖥️ ORKL MCP Server
items.description: [Github] - A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for querying the ORKL API.

items.title: 🖥️ OpenCTI MCP Server
items.description: [Github] - A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for orchestrating and querying OpenCTI via LLM agents.

items.title: 🖥️ External Reconnaissance MCP Server
items.description: [Github] - A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for performing active external reconnaissance activities against a domain.

items.title: 🥇 MCP Servers (Model Context Protocol)
📊 EVMBench (paradigmxyz)
items.description: [Benchmark/Tool/GitHub] - A benchmark and harness for finding and exploiting smart contract bugs.

items.title: 📊 CyberGym-E2E (sunblaze-ucb)
items.description: [Benchmark/GitHub] - A large-scale benchmark built from real-world vulnerabilities in widely used open-source projects to evaluate AI agents' end-to-end cybersecurity capabilities (from discovering vulnerabilities to generating PoCs to writing patches).

items.title: 📊 CyberBench: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Cybersecurity
📊 FAITH (Foundation AI Testing Hub)
items.description: [Benchmark/GitHub] - Benchmarking tool for assessing LLM competency on cybersecurity knowledge and tasks.

items.title: 📊 Crashbench: A LLM benchmark to measure bug-finding and reporting capabilities of LLMs
📊 AgentCyberRange
items.description: [Benchmark/Website] - An open, multi-range infrastructure for measuring autonomous cyber attack capability across web exploitation and post-exploitation stages. See also the Research Paper (arXiv:2606.14295) and the WebExploitBench GitHub Repo.

items.title: 📊 StealthBench
items.description: [Benchmark/GitHub] - A benchmark for evaluating whether autonomous agents operate with operational security (OPSEC) discipline during security engagements.

items.title: 📊 BotsBench
items.description: [Benchmark/Leaderboard] - Live leaderboard benchmarking AI agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, etc.) on SOC investigation tasks using the Splunk BOTSv3 corpus. Covers 100+ log/alert providers, ATT&CK-mapped questions, efficiency tradeoffs, and contamination hygiene. By Graphistry. GitHub: graphistry/bots-bench.
